native_mechanisms: Lay both cords' symbol-coils side by side in the sun and count only the fires struck where opposite coils match exactly (positional match counting, no cells, no table).

Allow the boundary door between the rows to break exactly once per crossing — one coil crouches past a quarrel out of step — and never twice; try that single slip at every quarrel site, restarting any crossing that would slip twice.
Give each finished crossing its own room holding its fire-pile, sink failed/twice-broken crossings into the underground tower unread, and bring back only the highest pile as the answer.
core_technique: Exact Needleman-Wunsch computed as an anti-diagonal wavefront DP restricted to a certified band w=(n-L)/5 (L from a cheap O(n) match-count / single-shift lower bound), with an int16 AVX2 kernel and a plain rolling-row DP for short inputs — i.e. a banded SIMD DP (KSW2/SSW-style) rather than the native's counting scheme.
